text:
raj: Quick ask — can someone create a saved search that combines orgs (acme + zenith), model_family=gen-xl, route=/generate, region=eu-west and status >= 500? Need it pinned to the EU ops dashboard for oncall. Also want p95 latency and kv_cache_miss counts in the results. I put a draft query below if that helps.

olivia: I can make this. paste the query and I’ll save it (and pin). name suggestion?

raj: Draft query (logsearch syntax):
```
org_id IN ("acme", "zenith") AND model.family = "gen-xl" AND route = "/generate" AND region = "eu-west-1" AND status_code >= 500
| stats p95(duration_ms) AS p95_ms, count() AS errors, sum(kv_cache_miss) AS kv_miss BY org_id, model.version
| sort -errors
```

olivia: Couple small changes — exclude canary traffic (tag.canary = true) and set default time range to last 1h. Also suggest using route.keyword if routes are exact. I’ll save as `eu-gen-crossorg-5xx-kv-p95` unless you want a different name.

sam: FYI: if you want to include status classes use `status_code >= 500 AND status_code < 600` for clarity.

jonathan: For alerts: we should avoid one-size-fits-all. Propose alert rule variants: per-org error rate > 0.5% OR absolute errors > 30 in 5m. I can help tune thresholds for acme vs zenith.

olivia: Saved view created and pinned (eu ops dashboard): https://app.redwood.com/logs/search/queries/eu-gen-crossorg-5xx-kv-p95 :white_check_mark:

oncall-bot: Saved view `eu-gen-crossorg-5xx-kv-p95` created by olivia (default time range: 1h, excludes tag.canary=true). Link: https://app.redwood.com/logs/search/queries/eu-gen-crossorg-5xx-kv-p95

elaine: Thanks — can you also add a dashboard panel with p95 and kv_miss rate split by org? That’ll help triage quickly.

olivia: Done — panel added to EU Ops dashboard: https://app.redwood.com/dashboards/eu-ops/panels/4312. I set legend by org_id and added a quick note in the saved query description about alerting. cc @jonathan

raj: Awesome, thanks everyone. I’ll reference the saved view in the postmortem checklist and link the dashboard panel. :thumbsup:

jonathan: I’ll follow up with a PR for alert rules (separate thread).

olivia: If anyone wants different time windows or a canary-inclusive variant, say so and I’ll save a copy.

sam: Nice work — concise and actionable.
